concepts.title: Cinematic Library
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one original, exceptionally polished, high fidelity UI mockup for the Wallpaper section of the macOS app All Set. Landscape 16:10, sharp legible text, straight-on full app window, no device frame or perspective. Design for a realistically buildable native SwiftUI interface. Dark navy-black surfaces, carefully restrained blue-violet illumination, generous spacing, precise hairline borders, soft corner radii, SF Pro style typography. Glass only for the two small navigation capsules; calm solid surfaces elsewhere. A small native traffic-light group and "All Set" at top left.
Navigation centered at top: "Island", "Desktop" selected, "Workspace", "Tools", "System". Second compact row: "Themes", "Widgets", "Favorites", "Wallpaper" selected, "Look & Layout", "Wallpaper Options", "On Your Desktop".
Below navigation one compact simple toolbar with content source labels "Aerial Videos", "Art", "My Videos", a search field "Search wallpapers…" and an outline heart. Use one white selected source treatment; avoid nested pill outlines.
Only wallpaper browsing and wallpaper preview imagery. No desktop widgets, clocks, calendars, themes collages, implementation notes, external annotations or watermarks. Use original beautiful landscapes or abstract wallpaper images, no third party logos. Keep image captions in their own readable space and distinguish primary apply from preview. Do not invent subscriptions, AI-generation controls or community feeds. Deliver one complete finished screen per image, not a contact sheet.
Layout: elegant cinematic discovery screen with Aerial Videos selected. Below the single toolbar a panoramic spotlight spanning the content width, around 36% of the whole window height: dramatic luminous turquoise and violet aurora over an Icelandic glacial lagoon and dark mountains, convincing original photography with great depth. The image fades to black only at its lower edge for readable white text; don't obscure the landscape with a big glass rectangle. Title at bottom left "Northern Drift", quiet eyebrow "FEATURED", secondary text "Live wallpaper · Available offline". Aligned bottom right white "Set Wallpaper" button, quieter "Preview" action and a simple heart. Tiny pause icon within hero bottom corner. Immediately underneath, a header "Discover wallpapers", restrained subtitle "A view for every mood.", with "See all" and small arrows on right. One complete row of five equal landscape cards: amber desert dunes "Golden Dunes", misty emerald woodland "Forest Haze", rose alpine sunrise "First Light", sapphire coast "Ocean Air", lavender abstract silk "Violet Flow". Each thumbnail has a small play badge when live; title and tiny Live or Still metadata BELOW the image on the dark page, never competing with photo details. Selected card gets one delicate blue rim. Bottom section "Explore by mood" contains four fully visible shorter scenic tiles "Nature", "Space", "Abstract", "Minimal". Fit hero, discovery row and mood tiles comfortably within the screen. Strong central cinematic beauty, restrained supporting art, expertly aligned controls.

Only wallpaper browsing and wallpaper preview imagery. No desktop widgets, clocks, calendars, themes collages, implementation notes, external annotations or watermarks. Use original beautiful landscapes or abstract wallpaper images, no third party logos. Keep image captions in their own readable space and distinguish primary apply from preview. Do not invent subscriptions, AI-generation controls or community feeds. Deliver one complete finished screen per image, not a contact sheet.
Layout: practical premium split-pane wallpaper studio, clearly different from a hero screen. Aerial Videos selected. Under toolbar a modest page heading "Wallpapers" and inline plain category labels "All", "Nature", "City", "Space", "Abstract". Content split into a 60% left browsing grid and 38% right fixed preview, with a narrow clean gutter and no nested cards. LEFT: two columns by three rows of crisp spacious landscape thumbnail images with titles BELOW each image: "Coastal Light" aerial aquamarine cliffs; "Northern Drift" aurora fjord; "Golden Dunes" amber dunes; "Forest Haze" emerald mist; "City After Dark" blue nighttime skyline; "Alpine Still" still snowy lake. Hearts small at thumbnail top right; simple tiny play symbols for videos; choose Coastal Light with thin cyan rim. Right: a big clean 16:10 preview of Coastal Light occupying upper 45% of panel, beautiful cliffs and gentle ocean foam, a pause symbol and subtle timeline along its lower edge. Under preview large title "Coastal Light", muted line "Aerial video · Available offline". A compact display selector row labelled "Display" with "Built-in Display"; a second row labelled "Fit" with "Fill". Show only these two simple settings with generous room. At panel bottom a full width white button "Set Wallpaper" and quieter "Preview on Desktop", with heart by title. A tiny unobtrusive footer "Preview changes before applying." Focus on large useful preview, organized library and very legible predictable controls. Clean typography, minimal decoration, realistic macOS productivity polish.

Layout: immersive wallpaper cinema with a refined bottom filmstrip, visually distinct from a grid. Entire canvas behind navigation is a breathtaking original mountain lake at indigo dusk, crisp snowy peaks, orange-pink horizon reflected in perfectly calm blue water, faint stars. Darken only near navigation and bottom for contrast. Navigation floats elegantly above image. Aerial Videos selected; toolbar floats just under navigation as a narrow restrained dark strip, no bulky container. Keep the middle half of the window completely free of text so the landscape is dominant. Near lower left an elegant caption block with small "AERIAL VIDEO", title "Alpine Afterglow", metadata "Live wallpaper · Available offline". Same baseline on lower right: white "Set Wallpaper", secondary outlined "Preview", heart and display selector "Built-in Display". Below that, one calm dark bottom tray displaying five equal landscape thumbnail cards with captions BELOW each picture: "Alpine Afterglow" selected, "Ocean Air" dramatic coast, "Northern Drift" aurora, "Golden Dunes" desert, "Quiet Orbit" purple space. The selected image has a thin white rim and small current-selection mark; other thumbnails are vivid but slightly subdued. Small previous/next arrows at tray edges, a discreet "Browse all" action aligned upper right of tray. Tray has rounded corners, minimal restrained translucency, no neon borders. Carefully balanced negative space, cinematic original landscape detail, readable restrained controls and large practical thumbnails. Full screen composition completely visible.
